SENDER_LISTS.DESCRIPTION: Decide how incoming email is triaged. Add full addresses like name@example.com or whole domains like example.com.

VIP.TITLE: VIP
VIP.DESCRIPTION: Conversations from these senders are marked high priority and labelled vip.

BLOCKED.TITLE: Blocked
BLOCKED.DESCRIPTION: Email from these senders is resolved on arrival and labelled filtered.

ALLOWED.TITLE: Allowed
ALLOWED.DESCRIPTION: Email from these senders is never filtered, even when it looks like a newsletter.

API.DELETE_ERROR: Could not remove this sender. Please try again.
